title: Terms of the Electric Service Agreement from Start to Closure: Schedule Values
content:
These values govern the life of an Electric Service Agreement under each rate schedule — the charge for opening it, how soon the schedule may be changed, the time-of-use bill protection period, the notice for stopping service, the final bill, refunds of credit balances and the transfer of an unpaid final balance.

## Values by schedule

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rate change lockout, months after a schedule takes effect | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Time-of-use bill protection, months after joining | 0 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| Connection charge, USD | 15.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 |
| Stop-service notice, business days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 20 |
| Final bill issued within, business days after the stop | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Smallest credit balance refunded by check, USD | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Prior balance transfer period, calendar days after the final bill due date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Terms explained

- **Connection charge** — a one-time charge for establishing a new service agreement, in USD.
- **Rate change lockout** — the months that must pass after a schedule takes effect before the customer may choose another schedule.
- **Time-of-use bill protection** — the months after joining the schedule during which time-of-use charges are compared with the base flat schedule and any excess is credited; 0 means the schedule offers no bill protection. It is 12 months on Schedules RT, REV and GST and 0 on RS, GS, GD and LP.
- **Stop-service notice** — the business days that must separate the stop-service request date from the stop effective date.
- **Final bill timing** — the business days after the stop effective date within which the final bill is issued.
- **Credit refund minimum** — the smallest credit balance on a closed agreement that is refunded by check; smaller balances are written off to the customer's benefit only on request.
- **Prior balance transfer period** — the calendar days after a final bill's due date after which its unpaid balance is transferred to another open agreement of the same customer.

## Schedule contrasts

| Item | Residential (RS, RT, REV) | GS and GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connection charge | 15.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 150.00 USD |
| Stop-service notice | 1 business day | 3 business days | 5 business days | 20 business days |

The rate change lockout (12 months), final bill timing (5 business days), credit refund minimum (1.00 USD) and prior balance transfer period (30 days) are the same on every schedule.
